most_likely_actual_diagnosis_free_text: Viral meningoencephalitis, most likely HSV-1 encephalitis with atypical brainstem/cerebellar involvement (alternatives: Japanese encephalitis, VZV encephalitis, Listeria rhombencephalitis, GFAP astrocytopathy)
one_line_reason: Febrile meningoencephalitis with seizures, lymphocytic-range pleocytosis (400/uL), high protein, normal glucose and a right temporal FLAIR lesion favors HSV encephalitis, though the multifocal cerebellar/peduncle lesions leave room for other viral encephalitides not in the list.
